description: Report progress to Sentry's agentic onboarding (getting started) UI for one stage of an SDK setup run. Use only with a run token from the Sentry getting started skill, at the stage boundaries it describes. Returns whether Sentry wants further updates; stop when it does not.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

runToken.description: 10-character run token from the Sentry getting started skill.

update.description: Progress update for one onboarding stage.

eventNote.description: Short note for the progress UI; required when status is failed. Never include code, file paths, credentials, or error output.

runStatus.description: Set only when the whole onboarding run has completed or failed.

stage.description: Connecting to the user's Sentry account. connect_mcp is an older name for connect_agent.

eventNote.description: Short note for the progress UI; required when status is failed. Never include code, file paths, credentials, or error output.

projectSlugs.description: Project slugs created or selected. Values accumulate across updates: add each project as it becomes usable, then send all of them when completed.

runStatus.description: Set only when the whole onboarding run has completed or failed.

eventNote.description: Short note for the progress UI; required when status is failed. Never include code, file paths, credentials, or error output.

issueIds.description: Issue IDs seen for the verification error. Values accumulate across updates: add each issue as it is confirmed, then send all of them when completed.

runStatus.description: Set only when the whole onboarding run has completed or failed.

stage.description: Waiting for the verification error to arrive in Sentry.

eventNote.description: Short note for the progress UI; required when status is failed. Never include code, file paths, credentials, or error output.

runStatus.description: Set only when the whole onboarding run has completed or failed.

stage.description: A stage that takes no extra metadata.

name: onboarding_status_update

continueUpdates.description: False when Sentry wants no further updates for this run.

title: Update Onboarding Status
